breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that K affects only the mode shape and instructed evaluating the Euler load from π²EI/L² (without K in the denominator). The generated specification correctly uses K directly in the Euler buckling formula as P_cr = π²EI/(KL)², computing KL = 1400 mm and substituting it into the denominator. This matches the ground truth prompt, which simply states to compute P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² without any caveat about K affecting only the mode shape.
